```javascript
# Pseudo DLT skeleton for silver_kafka
import dlt
import pyspark.sql.functions as F

@dlt.table
def silver_kafka():
    df = spark.readStream.format('kafka').option(...).load()
    df = df.selectExpr('CAST(value AS STRING) as json')
    parsed = spark.read.json(F.col('json'))
    return parsed
```
